title: Deduplicate add-missing-jumpstart-themes.py and add-j22-themes.py
description:
scripts/add-missing-jumpstart-themes.py (603 lines) and scripts/add-j22-themes.py (1377 lines) share substantial duplicated logic: Scryfall card resolution with collection batching + individual fallback + split card handling, theme data structures, and .dck file generation. The card resolution pattern is nearly identical between them (and also appears in scripts/import-deck.py).

Extract the shared card resolution logic into a utility (possibly extending scripts/scryfall.py with a resolve_cards() function), and unify the theme-building scaffolding so the scripts only contain their set-specific card data and any set-specific quirks.
